svg.title: OCR trilogy: one Tesseract engine, three deployments
svg.desc: A scan beam sweeps a pixelated word and turns it into crisp text. Below, the same amber Tesseract engine core sits in three housings: FastAPI on Heroku (2020), Flask-RESTX in a Docker Hub image (2021), and a Flask web UI with Heroku and Azure continuous deployment (2022).
svg.text: Tesseract OCR, shipped three ways · ties to Humana OCR
one engine · image in, text out · 2020 → 2022
same Tesseract core · new housing each year
